description_en: Creates a custom cloud computer template
description_zh: 创建自定义的云电脑模板
kebab_example: aliyun ecd create-bundle --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --image-id m-4zfb6zj728hhr0000 --desktop-type eds.enterprise_office.2c4g --root-disk-size-gib 80 --bundle-name testBundleName --description test --biz-language zh-CN --user-disk-size-gib 70 --root-disk-performance-level PL1 --user-disk-performance-level PL1 --api-version 2020-09-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateBundle

parameters.description_en: The region ID. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~196646~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: 地域ID。可以调用[DescribeRegions](~~196646~~)获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表。
parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/196646.html获取无影云电脑支持的地域列表
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en:
The instance type of the cloud computers. You can call the [DescribeBundles](~~436974~~) operation to query cloud computer templates and obtain the instance types supported by the cloud computers from the `DesktopType` response parameter.

> If you want the template to use a non-GPU-accelerated image, you can only select a non-GPU-accelerated instance type. If you want the template to use a GPU-accelerated image, you can only select a GPU-accelerated instance type.
parameters.description_zh:
云电脑规格。您可以调用[DescribeBundles](~~436974~~)查询云电脑模板，从返回的`DesktopType`参数获取当前支持的云电脑规格。

> 非GPU镜像只能选择非GPU规格，GPU镜像只能选择GPU规格。
parameters.help_en:

parameters.description_en:
The performance level (PL) of the system disk. When the cloud computer instance type that is specified by the DesktopType parameter is set to a graphical instance type or instance type with a high clock speed, you can set the performance level of the disks. For more information about the differences among disks at different PLs, see [Enhanced SSDs](~~122389~~).

Valid values:
